name: SPOT raw primary-MOC bounded production capture
purpose: Evaluate the already frozen NATIVE and STATIONARY plane-1 terminal inputs once with capture OFF and once with capture ON, without rerunning either six-step arm.

prior_attempt.rejection_phase: SYSTEM layout validation before PRE, FROZEN, OFF or ON was opened
prior_attempt.correction: Permit geometric negative ICODE, preserve the NALBP guard used by MCGSIG, and select each boundary albedo through -NZON exactly as MCGFCS does.

preparation.rule: Reconstruct the missing MACRO0, then require every retained prepared object and the reconstructed MACRO0 to match its frozen hash.

execution_budget.termination_scope: exact spawned process group; never killall

identity_and_immutability: Each arm's PRE, FROZEN, OFF and ON XSM object is a distinct regular file with a distinct inode.
Each OFF and ON result starts as a byte-identical fresh copy of the same frozen PRE.
NATIVE is bound only to arm code 1 and the declared NATIVE PRE/FROZEN hashes.
STATIONARY is bound only to arm code 2 and the declared STATIONARY PRE/FROZEN hashes.
Every common input is copied separately into each process directory and is hashed before and after the run.
The fresh OFF output must equal the older FROZEN output bit for bit.
The ON output must equal OFF bit for bit outside the single root SPOT-MOC-AUD directory.

independent_checker.native_arguments: TRACK SYSTEM PRE FROZEN OFF ON 1
independent_checker.stationary_arguments: TRACK SYSTEM PRE FROZEN OFF ON 2

publication.manifest: all regular artifact files except the manifest replay itself
publication.atomicity: publish only after every checker and input replay passes

interpretation_limits: The prior attempt was rejected by an incorrect independent-checker contract before the capture objects were opened; it provides no scientific classification.
CAPTURE-VALID certifies the declared execution identity, write-once tuple structure, source replay and raw-minus-input ledger; it is not an independently recomputed transport solution.
A finite RAW payload has no independent transport truth in this experiment and therefore cannot become a transport-error bound.
The two arms are parallel diagnostics and may not be ranked from this capture.
No mismatch may be repaired by a tolerance, fitted factor, relaxation, clipping or empirical coefficient.
